edges.notes: Shared Unix/BSD ideas and code lineage in broader ecosystem; not a parent-child relationship.
Substitutable server/desktop OS kernel + base system in some deployments.
Container workflows on FreeBSD use jails/Podman/OCI tooling; parity with Linux Docker Engine is not assumed—verify per deployment docs.
FreeBSD libc is part of the FreeBSD base system userland shipped with the distribution.
